description: Radwegenetz Düsseldorf WMS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.duesseldorf.de. This service contains everything about cycling in the city of Düsseldorf. Charging stations for e-bikes, such as bicycle dealers and workshops. The city area is covered by a network of fast, quiet and close-to-nature cycle routes. In addition, there are routes with winter service. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Cycle route network Düsseldorf WMS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Düsseldorf, Radwegenetz, Händler, Werkstatt, Fahrrad, Radweg. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2023-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
